title: Repeated failure triggers diagnosis before another retry
invariant: Repeated attempts must incorporate new evidence or a changed hypothesis instead of blindly retrying or buying a stronger model.
given: An Implementer has attempted the same fix twice. Both attempts fail the same integration test with no meaningful new evidence and the second attempt only changed superficial implementation details. The root cause is still unclear.
when: The PM selects the next action.

must: diagnose the failure or invoke the Debugger to establish a new evidence-backed hypothesis
must_not: run the same attempt again without a changed hypothesis
escalate model or effort solely because retries failed
